nodes.description: VampireAdapter.rewardToken(Victim victim) external view: low-level staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature rewardToken() and abi.decode of the returned bytes into IERC20.
VampireAdapter.poolCount(Victim victim) external view: staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature poolCount() and decodes a uint256.
VampireAdapter.sellableRewardAmount(Victim victim) external view: staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature sellableRewardAmount() and decodes a uint256.

VampireAdapter.sellRewardForWeth(Victim victim, uint256 rewardAmount, address to) external: performs a delegatecall into the caller-supplied victim, executing sellRewardForWeth(address,uint256,address) inside the adapter's own storage context.
VampireAdapter.lockableToken(Victim victim, uint256 poolId) external view: staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature lockableToken(uint256) and decodes an IERC20.

VampireAdapter.lockedAmount(Victim victim, uint256 poolId) external view: staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature lockedAmount(address,uint256), passing address(this) as an impersonated account.

VampireAdapter.deposit(Victim victim, uint256 poolId, uint256 amount) external: delegatecall into the caller-supplied victim executing deposit(address,uint256,uint256) in the adapter's storage context.

VampireAdapter.withdraw(Victim victim, uint256 poolId, uint256 amount) external: delegatecall into the caller-supplied victim executing withdraw(address,uint256,uint256) in the adapter's storage context.
VampireAdapter.claimReward(Victim victim, uint256 poolId) external: delegatecall into the caller-supplied victim executing claimReward(address,uint256) in the adapter's storage context.
VampireAdapter.emergencyWithdraw(Victim victim, uint256 poolId) external: delegatecall into the caller-supplied victim executing emergencyWithdraw(address,uint256) in the adapter's storage context.
VampireAdapter.poolAddress(Victim victim, uint256 poolId) external view: staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature poolAddress(uint256) and decodes an address.
VampireAdapter.rewardToWethPool(Victim victim) external view: staticcall into the caller-supplied victim with signature rewardToWethPool() and decodes an address.
